# Canonical command registry for Gobbo. One `alias::name` per line; the alias matches the `use ... as alias`
# in src-tauri/src/commands/mod.rs. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored.
# build.rs reads this file to register the Tauri permissions and to generate the `collect_commands!` invocation;
# scripts/check-generated.ts reads the same lines to guard the autogenerated permission files and capability.
# After changing this list run, from src-tauri: cargo test --lib write_bindings -- --ignored
